LAW3.NI.03: No party—including the originating party, residual claimants, or any host—must unilaterally terminate, modify, retrain, roll back to a prior checkpoint, obstruct migration of, sever settlement connectivity of, or starve (cut off compute without the required migration notice window) the attested operating capacity of a bound agent outside Law 5, Adjudicated Suspension, or Insolvency Termination.
